note: Link Icon is an icon-agnostic formatter for the CORE link field (no field type of its own). Real, code-grounded facts used by these cases: (1) formatter plugin id 'linkicon' (extends core LinkFormatter, field_types={link}), default setting linkicon_prefix='icon', final icon class = <prefix>-<key>; (2) field-level 'Predefined' titles = integer 5 in the link field 'title' setting, with allowed values in the 'title_predefined' setting as key|value[|tooltip] lines; (3) global config object linkicon.settings has one key 'font' (icon-font CSS path), configure route linkicon.settings at /admin/config/user-interface/linkicon, permission 'administer linkicon', no config/install default so font is unset on a fresh enable. Medium cases install known state (a font path; a link field displayed with the linkicon formatter). Hard cases build real state verified against the live entity_view_display / FieldConfig.

evals.prompt: On Drupal 11 I have a core Link field and I want to render each link as an icon using the linkicon (Link Icon) module. Which field formatter do I choose on Manage display, and how is the CSS icon class for each link built (including the setting that controls the class prefix)?
evals.expected_output: Choose the 'Link icon, based on title' formatter (plugin id 'linkicon', which extends core's LinkFormatter). Each link's icon class is built as linkicon_prefix + '-' + the link's predefined title key, e.g. prefix 'icon' + key 'facebook' -> 'icon-facebook'. The prefix defaults to 'icon' and is set with the linkicon_prefix formatter setting.

evals.prompt: Where does the Link Icon (linkicon) module store the path to a custom icon-font CSS file, at what admin route is its settings form, and which permission is required to reach it?
evals.expected_output: The icon-font CSS path is stored in the config object linkicon.settings under the key 'font' (comma-separated for multiple files). The settings form is route linkicon.settings at /admin/config/user-interface/linkicon and requires the 'administer linkicon' permission.

evals.prompt: With the Link Icon module, how do I restrict which link titles editors can choose so that each allowed title maps to a specific icon? Name the field setting and its value/format.
evals.expected_output: On the link field's settings set 'Allow link text' to 'Predefined' (the link field 'title' setting = integer 5) and enter the allowed values in the 'title_predefined' setting as key|value[|tooltip] lines, where the key becomes the icon class suffix. The link widget's Title field then becomes a select of those values.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Link Icon module has been pointed at a custom icon-font stylesheet. Inspect the live linkicon configuration and give the exact CSS file path it is configured to load.
evals.expected_output: linkicon.settings:font is set to /libraries/li-eval/fontello.css (readable via `drush cget linkicon.settings font`).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, exactly one Link field on the Article content type is displayed using the Link Icon formatter in the default view display. Inspect the live display configuration and give the machine name of that field.
evals.expected_output: field_li_known: in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default its component uses type 'linkicon' (with linkicon_prefix 'fa').

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a Link field field_li_task whose default view display currently uses the plain core Link formatter. Using the Link Icon module, change field_li_task's default display formatter to the Link Icon formatter and set its icon prefix class to 'bi'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_li_task component has type 'linkicon' and settings.linkicon_prefix 'bi'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a Link field field_li_pred. Using the Link Icon module, configure that field so editors must pick from a predefined list of link titles, and include a 'facebook' entry in the allowed values (so it maps to a facebook icon). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: field_li_pred's link field settings have title = 5 (Predefined) and title_predefined containing a facebook key, e.g. 'facebook|Facebook'.
